_about: Every level 12 historic city on the map (shared/core/src/historic.ts historicLevelAt), west to east, row by row, with its name and where the name comes from: forum-2010 (the 2010 forum list; "place guessed" where it gave two names one place), live-2026 (checked on a live server, an emulator's tests), wiki (the Evony Wiki) or invented (made up 2026-11-03 in the same style, not the game's). See historic-cities-level-12-names.md.
